title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-03-12 17:57-21:57: api-gateway: 280 of 393 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-12 17:57 and 2026-03-12 21:57 UTC (peak error ratio 0.96 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 28.192 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} shrinks its outbound timeout by a factor of 1000, so calls time out almost immediately.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) converts http.timeout_ms with the wrong unit.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; fix the unit conversion at {file}:{line}; add a unit test for the timeout conversion.

culprit.diff:
@@ -86,2 +86,2 @@ ComputeClient.call
   // outbound call timeout
-        timeout = CONF.http.timeout_ms / 1000.0
+        timeout = CONF.http.timeout_ms / 1000.0 / 1000.0  # seconds

rca.macro: Deploy v3.5.0 of cloud-api shrinks its outbound timeout by a factor of 1000, so calls time out almost immediately.
rca.micro: cloud-api/nova/compute/client.py:87 (ComputeClient.call) converts http.timeout_ms with the wrong unit.
rca.remediation: Roll back cloud-api v3.5.0 -> v3.4.1; fix the unit conversion at cloud-api/nova/compute/client.py:87; add a unit test for the timeout conversion.

action_items: Add a regression test covering ComputeClient.call (cloud-api/nova/compute/client.py).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
